# Xbox reconnaissance exhausted stock

Unmodified original captures retained from application 2.9.138. `baseline.png` shows the initial Xbox Classic board; `latest.png` shows all stock drawn, empty LEFT circle and RIGHT 2 of spades. The run recognised all 28 tableau and 24 stock identities but refused LEFT empty evidence after 24 acknowledged DRAW operations, before attempting Undo All. No restored acquisition or route authority is claimed.

The failure was the stock surface-continuity guard crossing the circle/logo: the full LEFT footprint contains zero white or pale-paper pixels. Pixel values, native 1920 × 1080 dimensions and artwork are unchanged. Tests derive expected identities from these originals; mutations are labelled synthetic.
